text: 中共中央政治局委员、外交部长王毅在北京同韩国外交部长赵显举行会谈。 王毅说，中韩是搬不走的近邻，保持睦邻友好是彼此的正确选择。双方坚持与邻为善、以邻为伴，保持各层级沟通对话，深化各领域务实合作，给两国人民带来福祉，也促进了地区和平与发展。中方始终重视中韩关系，愿同韩方进一步增进互信，在传统合作基础上，拓展人工智能、生物医药、绿色低碳、银发经济等新兴领域合作，培育经济增长新引擎，不断做大共同利益。
text_en: Member of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee and Foreign Minister Wang Yi held talks in Beijing with South Korean Foreign Minister Cho Hyun. Wang Yi said China and South Korea are close neighbors that cannot move away, and maintaining good-neighborly friendship is the right choice for both sides. The two sides persist in being good neighbors and partners, maintain communication and dialogue at all levels, and deepen practical cooperation in various fields, bringing benefits to the two peoples and also promoting regional peace and development. China has always attached importance to China-ROK relations and is willing to further enhance mutual trust with South Korea, and on the basis of traditional cooperation, expand cooperation in emerging fields such as artificial intelligence, biomedicine, green and low-carbon development, and the silver economy, cultivate new engines of economic growth, and continuously expand common interests.
